title: My Worth Is Not in What I Own
input: My Worth Is Not in What I Own

candidates.title: My Worth Is Not in What I Own

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lines: My worth is not in what I own
Not in the strength of flesh and bone
But in the costly wounds of love

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lines: My worth is not in skill or name
In win or lose, in pride or shame
But in the blood of Christ that flowed

lyrics.label: Chorus
lines: I will trust in Him, no other

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lines: As summer flowers, we fade and die
Fame, youth and beauty hurry by
But life eternal calls to us

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lines: I will not boast in wealth or might
But I will boast in knowing Christ

lyrics.label: Chorus
lines: I will trust in Him, no other

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lines: Two wonders here that I confess
My value fixed, my ransom paid

lyrics.label: Chorus
lines: I will trust in Him, no other
